proof_body:
by
  intro a b g l hg
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have ha : Nat.gcd a b * (a / Nat.gcd a b) = a := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b)
    have hb : Nat.gcd a b * (b / Nat.gcd a b) = b := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b)
    refine ⟨a / Nat.gcd a b, b / Nat.gcd a b, Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg, ha.symm, hb.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [ha]
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg
    rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (Nat.gcd a b) a, Nat.mul_assoc, hb]
  · rintro ⟨m, n, hc, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · rw [Nat.gcd_mul_left, hc.gcd_eq_one, Nat.mul_one]
    · rw [Nat.lcm_mul_left, hc.lcm_eq_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]
target_source: ∀ (a b g l : ℕ), 0 < g → ((Nat.gcd a b = g ∧ Nat.lcm a b = l) ↔ ∃ m n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m n ∧ a = g * m ∧ b = g * n ∧ l = g * m * n)
